notes.title: SwayBods - Available for BETA play test
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
SwayBods is available for play test, Here are a few notes: 
[list]
[*]  There may be bugs, hopefully few. Please let me know if you find any. 
[*]  There is no NDA or anything like that, so you can talk about the game with anyone you like, or even make videos if you are so inclined 
[*]  The play test will run for limited time. 
[*]  In terms of feedback, it will be great to know about gameplay satisfaction, level difficulty, bugs and any other constructive inputs. The feedback can be provided in the [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/1202105053041659924/1218630651797045441]playtest[/url] channel of SwayBods discord server. Please place your message for playtest in SwayBods discord server for me to share a key. 
[/list]

Thank you so much for your interest in my game. Really appreciate it!
